title: Low-plastic water kettles

recommendation.title: Glass for no plastic. Steel for durability.
recommendation.text: Trendglas is the clearest whole-kettle match; COSORI is the $39.99 budget candidate, with its lid/steam seal still unresolved.

summary: Five US listings, price ascending. Construction evidence is not a safety ranking. Prices exclude unquoted shipping/tax.
evidenceNote: Checked 2026-10-28 (US listings). Item price only; shipping and tax not quoted at checkout. No purchase or physical teardown. Material claims are not proof of zero migration or a health benefit.
caveat: No electric option is verified plastic-free as an entire appliance. Silicone is a separate polymer compromise, not the same claim as an ordinary-plastic-free water path. No shortlisted item has a fully verified small-silicone-only inventory; unknown seals stay unknown.

products.summary: Lowest verified item price. No temperature control. No model-specific long-term failure rate established; owner reports favor the steel lid, but hidden steam-contact parts remain unresolved.

products.attribution: Retailer specifies lead-free borosilicate glass and stove use; exact gallery shows glass lid/knob, handle, spout and body with no filter or seal shown. Strongest whole-kettle no-plastic construction match here, based on retailer specification and photos, not a laboratory audit. No interior coating listed; external safety print is permanent. Not a loud whistler; no auto shutoff. Customer reports include hot handle depending on burner placement and breakage after countertop impact. These are anecdotes, not failure rates. Fragility is the main cost/durability compromise. 30-day unused returns; buyer postage. Separate product warranty unverified; replacement lid available. Checked 2026-10-28 (US listings). Item price only; shipping and tax not quoted at checkout. No purchase or physical teardown. Material claims are not proof of zero migration or a health benefit.

products.name: SAKI Luna Electric Kettle Pro
products.summary: Costs far more than boil-only choices. Page reviews report a temperature-stuck glitch and exterior finish chipping with support follow-up; reviews can span earlier Luna generations, so not Pro-specific failure-rate proof. Older community silicone reports are not assumed to describe the current Pro revision.
products.verdict: Strongest electric declaration · premium, not whole-device plastic-free.

sources.title: CPSC: excluded ZWILLING ENFINIGY recall
sources.note: May 14, 2026 recall covers named ENFINIGY 1.5 L and Pro models for handle separation/burn risk. Not one of these five. Bounded brand/model web searches found no matching notice for these candidates; this was not a complete recall-database audit and is not safety certification.

sources.title: Community budget lane: owner disagreements
sources.note: Read public feed and 60-comment request. Owners specifically recommend the COSORI double-wall as the affordable steel-lid model, contradicting broad brand-level warnings. Secura users report pour-path plastic, leaking and a rust spot; not promoted. Older SAKI comments discuss a silicone lid seal, but do not establish construction of the current Luna Pro. Anonymous anecdotes, not migration tests; the thread makes unsupported broad safety claims which are not adopted here.

sources.title: COSORI returns
sources.note: 30 days from delivery for direct purchases, original condition/packaging and proof of purchase; RMA required. Approved returns receive prepaid label. Product page advertises two-year limited warranty; detailed exclusions not audited.

sources.note: Affiliate-supported guide identifies CDK-SE151-KUS: 1.5 L, seamless 304 chamber, steel inner lid/spout/filter and concealed element. BUT it explicitly calls the lid seal undisclosed while its FAQ overstates silicone-free construction. We retain the uncertainty, not the FAQ claim. Current brand page only says stainless steel; 304 is secondary evidence in this review.
